overview.description: The T. Rowe Price High Income Municipal ETF (THYM) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on high yield fixed income. THYM invests primarily in longer-term, low- to upper-medium quality municipal bonds THYM was launched on Nov 19, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
